title: Costume 솔로 #083 · super glamour · 닌자 · 기대기 · 버스 터미널 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, mid 40s goddess, super glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size; below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, voluminous curls chocolate brown hair — wearing a minimal black ninja costume of a tiny black wrap top of two small opaque cups crossed over her bust, a black micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, a black cloth headband and a black sash tied at her waist, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare. Pose: leaning a shoulder against the doorway, one knee bent, a hand on her thigh — most extreme super glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy black cotton, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy black cotton with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.

Background: a bright modern bus terminal with a clean pale concrete floor, a glass canopy, standard-height bus doors and a bench, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
